summary: Completed comprehensive testing of automated email workflow for member approval. All 6 required features tested successfully: registration with pending email, admin approval triggering email workflow, immediate approval email, scheduled credentials email (2-minute delay), temp_password storage and clearing, and admin panel functionality.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/register - Creates user with PENDING status
temp_password stored as base64 encoded during registration
Admin can view pending users list
POST /api/admin/update-user-status - Triggers email workflow when status = APPROVED
Approval email sent immediately with correct subject and content
Credentials email scheduled for 2-minute delay using asyncio.sleep(120)
temp_password retrieved, decoded, and cleared after approval
Approved users can login with original password
User denial does not trigger email workflow
Email content includes required elements (Director, credit score, mission briefing)
Tier level correctly mapped in credentials email (JUNIOR RECRUIT)
Background task execution using FastAPI BackgroundTasks
Email workflow logging confirmation in backend logs
